slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.8.0.2 Beta
slides.subtitle: Racing, jobs and fixes
slides.summary: Win back lost cars, expand your racing team and take on smoother deliveries.

slides.kicker: No Prep Knights and car meets
slides.title: Race to win your car back
slides.summary: Lost a car in a pink-slip race? You may meet its new owner and get another shot.
facts: Win a pink-slip rematch to reclaim your lost build
Car meets can bring back a past rival and your car
No Prep Knights progress is tracked by map
Newly won prize cars now come with used mileage

slides.title: More ways to race
slides.summary: Bring more cars to drag weekends and make more use of your team garage.
facts: Register cars in multiple classes before starting the event
Choose to spectate or end the day when your races are done
Racing Team cars can use the dyno and fuel services
Pit fuel offers regular, premium and E85 for compatible cars
Race offers show the amount your team receives when you drive

slides.title: Ready for the road
slides.summary: New drag tires and improvements to Broker routes and garage capacity.
facts: RLS drag slicks, radials and front runners for supported wheels
Broker loads are added to your route automatically
Completed pickups and deliveries clear from the route
Garage free slots account for space across your garages
Loaded gooseneck job trailers have a raised hitch

slides.title: A smoother career
slides.summary: Fuel, workshops, taxis and events get a round of fixes.
facts: Fuel Hardware has its own garage and workshop entry
Personal tuning and parts allow up to two broken parts
Fuel pumps pause when physics is paused
A crashed taxi can skip ahead and continue the ride
Fixes for saved engine damage, racing events and freeroam refueling
